opennyai_summary.final__decision:
This Court, at this stage, is not inclined to allow the revision petition of the petitioner.
However, counsel for petitioner seeks some more time to place judgments on record; he is permitted to do so.
In the meantime, it is made clear that there is no stay order by this Court, and the trial Court shall proceed irrespective.
6. Order be uploaded on the website of this court.
